import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.codex/skills/docx')
from scripts.document import Document

doc = Document('unpacked')
editor = doc["word/document.xml"]
dom = editor.dom

# Find all paragraphs that use heading styles
from xml.dom import minidom

paras = dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    pPr = p.getElementsByTagName("w:pPr")
    style = None
    if pPr:
        pStyle = pPr[0].getElementsByTagName("w:pStyle")
        if pStyle:
            style = pStyle[0].getAttribute("w:val")
    text = ""
    for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
        text += t.firstChild.nodeValue if t.firstChild else ""
    # Only print paragraphs with heading styles or all text
    if style and ("Heading" in style or "Title" in style or "Subtitle" in style):
        print(f"[{i}] style={style} text={text!r}")

import re

with open('unpacked/word/document.xml', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.codex/skills/docx')
from scripts.document import Document

doc = Document('unpacked')
editor = doc["word/document.xml"]
dom = editor.dom

# Find all paragraphs that use heading styles
from xml.dom import minidom

paras = dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    pPr = p.getElementsByTagName("w:pPr")
    style = None
    if pPr:
        pStyle = pPr[0].getElementsByTagName("w:pStyle")
        if pStyle:
            style = pStyle[0].getAttribute("w:val")
    text = ""
    for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
        text += t.firstChild.nodeValue if t.firstChild else ""
    # Only print paragraphs with heading styles or all text
    if style and ("Heading" in style or "Title" in style or "Subtitle" in style):
        print(f"[{i}] style={style} text={text!r}")
